generation.explanation: With $1 at 100% annual interest compounded $n$ times per year, the balance after one year is $\left(1+\frac1n\right)^n$. As $n$ grows without bound, this approaches the number $e\approx2.71828$, so continuously compounded interest turns $1 into $e$ after one year.
